description: Dependency update policy. See README 'Dependency versions' for the reasoning behind each group.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: TypeScript, oxlint, and oxlint-tsgolint must match @effect/tsgo's support table; `effect-tsgo patch` fails `bun install` otherwise, so bump them as one PR and let CI decide.
Daily prerelease builds published under the `latest` dist-tag. A semver range resolves to the stale `0.0.0-dev` stub, so track the tag instead.

Effect 4 release candidates rename APIs between rcs; every bump must arrive as a CI-checked PR. @effect/platform-bun and @effect/vitest are released in lockstep with effect (same rc number) and are pinned exactly, so they must move in the same PR.
Tooling that is not coupled to anything else. @types/node tracks the Node major in .node-version.
Node majors are chosen by hand: bump .node-version, engines.node, and @types/node together after checking that @effect/vitest/utils works on the new major (it does not on Node 26).
